description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10^0 to 10^3, and tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and tick labels at 65, 70, 75, and 80. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, triangle marker, solid line), IKE (red, triangle marker, solid line), MEND (brown, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (purple, square marker, solid line), and ROME (green, square marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 61 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 78 at 10^3. The FT line begins at around 62 at 3 and rises to about 80 at 10^3. The IKE line commences at roughly 66 at 3 and reaches around 84 at 10^3. The MEND line starts at approximately 65 at 3 and increases to about 87 at 10^3. The MEMIT line begins at around 68 at 10 and rises to approximately 86 at 10^3. The ROME line starts at roughly 75 at 10 and reaches around 88 at 10^3. All lines exhibit an upward trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
